833-3147-3827-5607.notablePrerequisites: Soul of Windgrace and Klauth can attack without taking damage.
833-3147-3827-5607.description:
Declare Klauth and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Klauth and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Klauth trigger, adding at least nine mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Azorius Chancery from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Azorius Chancery, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

2021-2060-3062-6627.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

1251-2043-7826.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Bag End Banquet that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Bag End Banquet token enters, it triggers, creating three Food tokens.
Activate the Bag End Banquet token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Food you control.
Repeat
1251-2043-7826.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {3} if you control additional Food(s) as you start the combo. You can also tap the original Bag End Banquet for mana after the Foods are created initially if you're able to do so.

1117-3689-6518-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
1117-3689-6518-7693.description:
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

225-757-3094.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

240-2511-5295-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat from step 2.

1247-5963-7308.description:
Activate Marvin using Mona Lisa's ability by tapping it, adding an amount of colored mana equal to Marvin's power.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2366-5702-6633-7288.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-5702-6633-7288.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Groundchuck & Dirtbag triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

2533-4681-5147-6913.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Chameleon from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Chameleon enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Chameleon.
Repeat.

2906-4046-7070.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
2906-4046-7070.description:
Activate Outrider en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Outrider en-Kor.
The Outrider en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Outrider en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Rakdos.
Repeat.

3054-3416-5670-6458.easyPrerequisites:
You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
3054-3416-5670-6458.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the Vampire and Oathsworn Vampire enter, Thunder of Unity triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life and each opponent to lose 2 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader twice by paying 2 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire and the Vampire token, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

969-3204-4251-4364.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Godo must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
969-3204-4251-4364.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Godo and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Godo trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Godo trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Godo from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

654-730-1479-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
654-730-1479-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Emeria Angel trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

7-586-5258-5618-5686.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
7-586-5258-5618-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2773-4050-4133.description:
Cast Soul Collector by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Soul Collector enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers, causing Soul Collector to deal damage to itself equal to its power.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Soul Collector, adding one mana of any color.
When Soul Collector dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 2.

1753-3259-5734.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control other than Death Tyrant.
1753-3259-5734.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any creature you control except Death Tyrant, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies, Death Tyrant triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat each combat phase.

2664-3263-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Fortitude, adding {2}.
Fortitude triggers, returning itself to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Fortitude by paying {2}, attaching it to a creature you control.
Repeat.

888-1167-3094-5159.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Mindslaver that is a 4/4 artifact creature named Mishra's Warform in addition to it's other types.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it, targeting an opponent.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Mishra's Warform's ability, targeting any other opponent.
Activate Tawnos by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, copying Mishra's Warform's ability, targeting any other opponent.
Resolve all Mishra's Warform abilities, causing you to gain control of the targeted opponents during their next turns.
Repeat during each of your turns.

543-2021-3129.notablePrerequisites: Colossus of Akros is not monstrous.
543-2021-3129.description:
Activate Colossus of Akros by paying {10}, putting twenty +1/+1 counters on it and causing it to become monstrous.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting twenty growth counters on itself.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.
